Request timestamps are not capture dates unless actual_capture_timestamp is present. Asset capture dates can differ from their parent.
The homepage image capture is 27 seconds after the chosen homepage HTML capture and requires a documented same-crawl exception to a strict cutoff.
No CSS, logo, favicon, font declarations or exact page geometry have been verified.
Published source material, titles, credits, historical contact details and third-party permissions require separate review.
This report does not create, update or deploy a GitHub repository.

Archive-wide CDX index is still incomplete; all exact payload availability requires real acquisition.
